title: Observation 0.1
description: A typed fact observed from agent output or customer-side state. An observation is evidence, never a verdict: it carries no pass/fail, score, expected value, or threshold. Keeping judgment out of this object is what keeps evaluation intelligence on the Redbeak side and makes the adapter an integration boundary rather than a customer-controlled scorer.

value.description: The observed value itself. Any JSON type, because facts are domain-shaped.
